setup_ready.description: The project's harness setup is complete and the BMad runtime is prepared.
setup_ready.how: run the bootstrap skill, then `harness begin` again with the same request

entry_tracked.description: The work session tracks the Epic, Feature, Story or Bug the work started from.
entry_tracked.how: read the item with tracker_get_work_item, then run `harness work-session track --work-item <key>`

entry_refined_now.description: The starting item's text passes validate-artifact for its type.
entry_refined_now.how: write it in its type's template with enrich-work-item and publish it after the user approves the text

entry_is_parent.description: The starting item is an Epic or a Feature.
entry_is_parent.how: nothing to do: this describes the starting item

any_published.description: This work session published a work item the user approved.
any_published.how: nothing to do: this records progress

published_after_approach.description: A work item was published after the approach was approved, so the item carries the approach.
published_after_approach.how: update the item from the approved approach with enrich-work-item (one item) or amend-workitems (an Epic or Feature tree)

approach_drafted.description: The discovery approach is saved as a document of the item the work is for.
approach_drafted.how: let bmad-build write the approach where `harness document path --type approach` says

stories_exist.description: The starting Epic or Feature has its Stories in the tracker.

story_refined.how: write it in the Story template with enrich-work-item and publish it after the user approves the text

plan_approved.description: An implementation plan for that Story or Bug was approved and has not changed since.
plan_approved.how: save the Story's implementation plan and have the user approve it with implementation-confirm, as generate-breakdown-work-items does before proposing Tasks

tasks_parented.description: The tracker holds at least one Task under that Story or Bug, and every Task under it names it as parent.
tasks_parented.how: break the Story or Bug down into Tasks in the selected tracker

risk_approved.description: The Story's risk document was approved as it reads now.
risk_approved.how: write it where `harness document path --type risk-assessment --item <key>` says, show it, and ask approve-document

verification_planned.description: The Story's verification document was approved as it reads now.
verification_planned.how: write it where `harness document path --type verification-plan --item <key>` says, show it, and ask approve-document

manifest_built.how: build it with `harness workflow manifest` at `harness document path --type reading-manifest --item <key>`

work_item_linked.description: The work session names the Story or Bug it implements.
work_item_linked.how: run `harness work-session link --work-item <key>` for the Story or Bug being implemented

work_item_started.description: The tracker holds that Story or Bug, and it is in progress.
work_item_started.how: start the Story or Bug so the tracker shows it in progress

code_changed.description: Code changed since the Story was linked.
code_changed.how: implement the Story's Tasks with implement-story

tests_with_code.description: Source files changed since the work item was linked come with changed tests, as the settings' tests_required pairs them.
tests_with_code.how: add or update the tests that cover the changed source files

checks_passed.description: Every configured check that applies to the changed files passed on the code as it is now.
checks_passed.how: run the project's checks with scripts/harness/checks.py and fix what fails

guarded_paths_verified.description: Each changed guarded path has its evidence for the code as it is now: its check passed, or the user confirmed it by hand.
guarded_paths_verified.how: run the guarded path's check, or show the change to the user and record their manual confirmation

review_ready.description: The review stage recorded a `ready` verdict for the code as it is now.
review_ready.how: run the review stage; it records the verdict with scripts/harness/review_verdict.py

verification_recorded.description: The tracker holds a verification artifact for the work item.
verification_recorded.how: publish the verification evidence to the work item

resolution_reported.description: The tracker holds a resolution report for the work item.
resolution_reported.how: publish the resolution report to the work item

story_done.description: The tracker shows the Story done.
story_done.how: mark it done after resolve-ticket published its reports

entry_done.description: The tracker shows the starting Epic or Feature done.
entry_done.how: close it with finish-feature-development once all its Stories are done

methods_selected.description: A human has selected at least one planning method in the active round.
methods_selected.how: resume the durable harness elicitation chooser and capture the selection

methods_applied.description: Selected source methods have recorded human Apply or Reject decisions for unchanged result artifacts.
methods_applied.how: resume harness elicitation status/present/result; preserve each actual human decision

route.say: Set up the project, then run `harness begin` again with the same request.
When the request names a work item (an id or a link), read it with tracker_get_work_item and run the command with its key. Otherwise ask the gate.
Shape the idea with plan-initiative, then ask the gate: continue into technical discovery, or stop with the brief or spec.
The user kept the brief or spec as the result. The work is complete.
Investigate the request and the code with bmad-build; when the investigation is done it asks the gate.
Resume the durable harness elicitation chooser; only its captured human selection completes this step.
Resume the durable chooser and apply each selected source method; show each result and capture its Apply/Reject/Direction decision.
Draft the approach with bmad-build and save it at the path the command gives.
Review the approach at the chosen depth (bmad-build runs bmad-review), triage the findings, show the approach and ask the gate with it as --artifact.
Draft the item the work is for, show the draft, ask the gate, create it, read it back, then track it with the command.

Write the starting item in its type's template with enrich-work-item (amend-workitems for an Epic or Feature tree), keeping the draft as Original Description; show it, ask the gate, update the item and read it back.
Split the Epic or Feature with decompose-backlog: the split is approved first, then the item bodies with publish-items.
Save the Story's implementation plan at the path the command gives, show it, and ask the gate with it as --artifact.
Propose the Story's Tasks from its approved plan, with Staging, Review and Breakdown last; show them, ask the gate, create them under the Story and read them back.
Build the reading manifest over the Story's approved plan and documents with `harness workflow manifest`, saved at the path the command gives.
Write any technical spec the Story still lacks with write-spec, then implement it Task by Task with implement-story.
